a little note for my favourite human

You deserve the
softest kind of happiness.

This is the soft part of the surprise, Anaya. Read it slowly, keep the parts that make you smile, and remember that someone is cheering for your happiness in all the ordinary moments too.

Funny in the best way 😂Caring heart ♡Lovely soul 🌷Beautiful inside & out ✨Kind-hearted always 🫶One of a kind 💗

Dear Anaya,

Happy birthday, bestie. I hope you know how incredibly special you are. You're funny, caring, lovely, beautiful, kind-hearted, and somehow still a little bit silly in the most perfect way. You bring your own kind of light into the lives around you. Your humour can make a regular moment feel memorable; your caring side shows that you notice people; and your kind heart is a lovely thing to carry through the world. You deserve to have that same warmth coming back to you.

I love you so much, bestie, and more than anything I want you to be happy. I hope life is gentle with your heart. I hope you are surrounded by people who respect your boundaries, celebrate your wins, look out for you when things feel heavy, and remind you that you never have to earn kindness. I wish you safety, peace, and protection wherever life takes you — not because you are fragile, but because you matter. I hope you get a hundred reasons to laugh, little things to look forward to, and the courage to chase every dream that matters to you.

Never feel like you have to be perfect to be loved. You already matter exactly as you are. Keep being your funny, caring, lovely, kind-hearted self. Please take care of yourself, celebrate your wins, and remember that you deserve good things—not just on your birthday, but on ordinary Tuesdays too.

May this next chapter bring you peaceful mornings, unexpected laughs, happy little surprises, beautiful memories, confidence to try new things, and people who choose kindness every time. I hope you keep discovering things that excite you, keep laughing at your own silly jokes, and keep becoming more and more yourself. Today is about celebrating you, and I hope it makes you smile as much as you make others smile. 💗

Always cheering for you, your bestie ♡

open whenever you need a smile

Little things I hope you always know. 💌

Tap a note. Each one has a little more to say.

😂Your funny side is a gifttap to open

You have that lovely way of making a moment lighter. The silly comments, unexpected jokes, and little bits of chaos are part of what makes you you. I hope you never feel you have to hide that playful side to be taken seriously — your laughter deserves space, too.

🫶Your caring heart matterstap to open

The way you care is one of the most beautiful things about you. I hope you remember that your kindness is valuable, but you deserve care in return as well. You can be there for people and still rest, say no, ask for help, and let people show up for you.

🌷You are lovely as you aretap to open

Your beauty is not only about how you look. It is also in your warmth, your expressions, your humour, your little habits, and the way you make a conversation feel. You don't have to be flawless or have every day figured out to be wonderful. You already bring something uniquely yours.

🛡️I wish you safety and happinesstap to open

More than anything, I want life to be kind to you. I hope you always have safe places to rest, trustworthy people beside you, courage when you need it, and peace when you need a break. I hope you feel protected without feeling held back, supported without being judged, and loved without needing to pretend to be someone else.
